previous_statement: Fix any real eta with 0<=eta<=eta_K. From eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}, the defining order property of a minimum gives eta<=rho_fac, eta<=(24*K)^(-1), and eta<=1; hence 0<=eta<=min{(24*K)^(-1),1}. Since K>0, multiplying eta<=(24*K)^(-1)=1/(24*K) by 3*K and by 4*K respectively gives 3*K*eta<=3/24=1/8<1 and 4*K*eta<=4/24=1/6<1/2.
new_statement: Fix any real eta with 0<=eta<=eta_K. Equation (1.8) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting and the defining order property of a minimum give eta<=rho_fac, eta<=(24*K)^(-1), and eta<=1; hence 0<=eta<=min{(24*K)^(-1),1}. Equation (1.6) makes K>=1>0, so multiplying eta<=(24*K)^(-1)=1/(24*K) by 3*K and by 4*K gives 3*K*eta<=3/24=1/8<1 and 4*K*eta<=4/24=1/6<1/2.
